# OneLineWeb

Data URIs are a web standard that allows you to embed inline data (such as documents, images, or code) directly into a text string instead of linking to an external server.

This repository contains Data URIs that are fully functional websites. Just copy the code and paste it into your browser's address bar.


# Glitchy Clock

![](./media/glitchy-clock.webp)

Uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript, the Web Audio API, WebGL, and the Canvas API to create an interactive clock.

```yaml
data:text/html,%3Cscript%3Efetch('data:;base64,').then(r=%3Enew Response(r.body.pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate-raw'))).text()).then(t=%3E%7Bdocument.open();document.write(t);document.close()%7D)%3C/script%3E
```


# Compile locally

A custom script is used to compress the Data URI to make the most of the URI's limited size. You can run the script locally:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Bittu5134/OneLineWeb.git
cd OneLineWeb
npm install
npm run dev
```
